r.b: Q: What is the attendance capacity for this YCS?

r: Due to safety, health, and fire regulations, we have seating for up to 2,500 Duelists for this YCS (this is the total Duelist venue capacity). We urge you to pre-register online to have a better chance of being able to play in the Main Events. If the venue reaches capacity, additional Duelists will not be allowed to enter the hall. As space opens up from the Main Events, we will offer numerous Public Events that you will still be able to participate in throughout the weekend.

r.b: Q: How many Main Events will be at YCS Houston, TX?

r: YCS Houston, TX will feature two Main Events. The Genesys Main Event Day 1 will be held on Friday, October 16
and Day 2 on Sunday, October 18
. The Advanced Main Event Day 1 will be held on Saturday, October 17
and Day 2 on Sunday, October 18
. If a Duelist makes Day 2 for both events, they will need to choose which Day 2 they want to compete in once the standings are posted at the end of Saturday, October 17

r.b: Q: What are the Deck-building requirements for the Main Events?

r: Duelists can find detailed information about Deck-building for Advanced and Genesys on the Deck construction page, https://www.yugioh-card.com/en/limited/
Here is the basic information:
Decks must follow the Forbidden & Limited List, which can be viewed at https://www.yugioh-card.com/en/limited/list_2026-05-18/
For information on how to submit your Advanced Deck List, please see

r: Genesys rules are simple:
No Link Monsters or Pendulum Monsters are allowed. All other cards are allowed. The original field layout is used, with no Extra Monster Zones nor Pendulum Zones.
The standard Forbidden & Limited Cards list is not used. All those cards can be used, except Link Monsters and Pendulum Monsters. Usual limit of 3 copies max of any card still applies.

Deck construction uses a point system. Some cards are assigned a point value; most cards cost zero points. The total point cost of cards in your Main Deck, Extra Deck, and Side Deck (combined) cannot exceed the point cap for that event.

For the Genesys Main Event, we will use the 100 Points cap for Deck-building. Click the link below for the current Genesys Points list. Genesys Deck List must be submitted through NEURON, the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG support app.
https://www.yugioh-card.com/en/genesys
For information on how to submit your Genesys Deck List, please see

Q: How many Rounds will the Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series have?

r: The total number of Duelists in each of the Main Events, Advanced and Genesys, will determine the number of Rounds that are played in that specific Main Event.

r.b: Q: How many Duelists will advance to Day 2?

r: If there are 256 or fewer Duelists registered for one of the Main Events, Advanced or Genesys, then the Top 64 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 15 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2 for that specific Main Event.
If there are 257 – 512 Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 64 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 18 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.
If there are 513 – 1024 Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 128 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 18 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.
If there are 1025 – 2048 Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 256 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 21 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.
If there are 2049 or more Duelists registered for the YCS, then the Top 256 Duelists OR Duelists with a minimum of 21 Points, whichever number is larger, will advance to Day 2.

r.b: Q: What cards are legal for play?

r: Please check the “Products” page online at https://www.yugioh‐card.com/en/products/ for the most current legality dates of Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME product releases, prior to preparing your Deck for the event.
Cards that have been altered from their original appearance with surface decoration may be used for play
only if the alterations do not obscure any portion of the card text, make the illustration difficult to recognize, or make the card distinguishable from other cards in the Deck while it is face-down.
If a card’s surface decoration renders the card unrecognizable at first glance, then the card is not allowed for tournament play.

The Head Judge of the event has final arbitration on whether or not altered cards may be used at the tournament. Duelists are responsible for determining whether or not their altered cards are acceptable for use before the start of the tournament.

r: For this YCS, Duelists will need to register online to secure a seat to compete in the Advanced Main Event.
Duelists can register online here:
https://registration.yugioh-card.com/

If you have not used the site to register for a YCS or WCQ event, you will need to create an account in order to register. You can do this at any time, you do not need to wait for the event registration to open to register an account.
Registration will remain open until either all available seats in the Advanced Main Event are sold out or until Friday, October 16, 2026 at 12:00 PM CT (whichever comes first).
Space is limited.

r.b: Duelists who successfully register must still arrive at the YCS and check in on Friday, October 16, 2026 between 12:00 PM CT and 6:00 PM CT to confirm their seat in the Tournament or their seat will be forfeited, and their entry will be refunded after the YCS. If you are also playing in the Genesys Main Event, you may also check in for the Advanced Main Event on Thursday, October 15, 2026 between 12:00 PM CT and 6:00 PM CT.

r: You must already have submitted a Deck List for the Advanced Main Event, but you can make changes to your Deck List until Friday 2PM CT. You do not need to check in on Friday for the Advanced Main Event if you check in on Thursday.

If you are not able to check in on Friday, October 16, 2026 prior to 6:00 PM CT due to travel or other issues, you will need to contact Yu-Gi-Oh! Registration staff at us-ygo-registration@kde-us.com no later than 11:00 AM CT on Friday, October 16, 2026 to make alternative check-in arrangements.
Any Duelist that does not attend a YCS they registered for and does not reach out to the registration website team beforehand will be blocked from registering online for future YCS events.
We urge you to register online for the event due to seating capacity.

r.b: Q: When do I turn in my Deck List for the Advanced Main Event?

r: Deck Lists are due online by 2:00 PM CT on Friday, October 16, 2026.
Duelists who do not turn in their Deck Lists by this deadline, will

forfeit their seat and their entry will be refunded after the YCS. Any Duelist that does not attend a YCS they registered for and does not reach out to the registration website team at us-ygo-registration@kde-us.com beforehand will be blocked from registering online for future YCS/WCQ events.
Deck Lists must be submitted through the online system. Physical copies of a Deck List will not be accepted onsite for the YCS.
Even if you are participating in the Genesys Main Event on Friday, this Deck submission deadline still applies.

r.u: Once a Deck List has been submitted, you can update and resubmit it up until the registration deadline of 2:00 PM CT on Friday, October 16, 2026.

r.b: Q: Will there be online registration for Public Events for YCS Houston, TX?

Q. What is the Prize Wall?

r: The Prize Wall is an extension of Public Events! In addition to earning exclusive prizes for participating in Public Events, Duelists will also receive prize tickets. You can spend these prize tickets at the Prize Wall for various items offered. These items are subject to change, and to availability.

r.u: How do I earn Prize Tickets?

r: Each time you sign up for a Public Event you will receive a prize ticket, and additional prize tickets will be distributed to the top finishers. The number of tickets awarded for doing well depends on the type of tournament. Any tickets found in this table are in addition to any specific prizing for the specific tournament.

r.b: Q: What is the cost to register for the Yu-Gi-Oh! Charity Tournament?

r: Duelists will pay $25.00 to receive four (4) tournament packs and registration in the event. This is the cost of four (4) tournament packs in the local currency, including any taxes and fees.

r.b: Q: What charity does the money from the Yu-Gi-Oh! Charity Tournament go to?

r: The money collected from the Yu-Gi-Oh! Charity Tournament will be donated to the Red Cross International for their continuing efforts to help with disaster relief.

The Yu-Gi-Oh! Championship Series (“YCS”) returns this weekend for three more exciting days of Dueling! This time, the competition will take place at the Reliant Center in Houston, Texas. The Dueling kicks off today with the first day of the Genesys Main Event. A huge Genesys points update affecting over 300 cards took effect just over a week ago, and YCS Houston will give Duelists in North America their first opportunity to compete with those changes at a high competitive level. On Saturday, the first day of the Advanced Main Event will begin. Both the Genesys Main Event and Advanced Main Event are likely to be heavily impacted by the release of the
booster set, which just launched a week ago on October 9, 2026.

Main Event this weekend, including an Ultra Rare

r: with new artwork and a gorgeous trophy that features it. Only one Duelist in each of the two Main Events will be able to take home those coveted first place prizes, and YCS Houston will test all of the competitors’ skill, luck, and Deck-building ingenuity.

TRADING CARD GAME community are abuzz with discussion about the upcoming Forbidden & Limited List announcement! 34 cards are about to be added to the Forbidden List, and 8 cards will be added to the Limited List. Be sure to watch so that you can be the first to know the upcoming changes.
